author: Trabahero.PH
title: We're Hiring Illustrators, Sketchers & Cartoonists for AI Project
content:
**WE'RE HIRING! ILLUSTRATORS, SKETCHERS & CARTOONISTS!**

**TRABAHERO PH | Your Next Opportunity Starts Here!**

Are you passionate about digital art, character design, or creative illustration?

**Turing is looking for talented artists to contribute to an exciting AI project!** Interns, fresh graduates, emerging artists, and experienced professionals are welcome!

**JOB DETAILS**

Company: Turing

Position: Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist

Location: Fully Remote

Compensation: Paid in USD (per approved task; rate not specified)

Project Duration: 10–12 weeks

Commitment: 20–40 hours/week

Start: After onboarding and portfolio approval

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop

Digital Illustration & Sketching

Character Design & Cartooning

Composition, Color & Perspective

Creativity & Attention to Detail

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Strong art portfolio showcasing your skills

Experience with Procreate, Clip Studio Paint, Affinity, or similar tools

Ability to maintain character consistency across different styles

Familiarity with surreal, cinematic, retro, steampunk, or other visual styles is a plus

Able to work independently and meet deadlines

**YOUR ROLE**

Create high-quality character illustrations from references.

Develop creative variations while preserving character identity.

Adapt artwork to different artistic styles.

Refine designs based on project feedback.

Document creative choices and submit polished artwork.

**HOW TO APPLY**

**trabaheroph@gmail.com**

**Subject:** Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist

Attach your updated CV and **art portfolio** (Behance, ArtStation, Google Drive, or personal website).

Shortlisted applicants will undergo portfolio review before onboarding.
budget: USD per approved task (rate not specified)

author: Rully Caling
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content:
Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator

We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds.

Quality level matching the attached characters

Requirements:

- Japanese anime art style (see attached images)

- Experience with 2D game character art

- Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors)

-work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring)

To apply: Send your portfolio.

Feel free to reach out!
